qualifier: CXCR4 signalling with Cdc42-driven pseudopod extension
name: CXCR4-linked chemotaxis with Cdc42-driven pseudopod extension
rationale: Members are chemotaxis and directed migration of T, mast, dendritic cells and astrocytes; CXCL12-CXCR4 signalling, Cdc42/PLC-PKC transduction and pseudopodium assembly separate it from chemokine-receptor, B-cell and S1P/lymph-node homing neighbours.

qualifier: astrocyte versus oligodendrocyte and neuron choice
name: Glial fate specification: astrocyte versus oligodendrocyte and neuron
rationale: All members govern which glial or neuronal fate a neural progenitor adopts, favouring astrocytes; neighbours instead cover neuroblast proliferation, myelination and neural tube patterning.

name: Motor coordination, locomotion and inhibitory glycinergic neurotransmission
rationale: Members concern motor and sensory behaviours (walking, righting, proprioception, touch) and their neural control; glycinergic/GABA inhibitory transmission and respiratory neural control distinguish it from exploratory, vocal and social behaviour neighbours.

name: Hox-driven axial patterning and somite segmentation
rationale: Members are anterior-posterior and dorsal-ventral body-plan patterning events including Hox clusters, rhombomeres, neural plate and somitogenesis; the Hox clusters and somite segmentation distinguish it from neural tube, axial mesoderm and limb/craniofacial neighbours.

qualifier: bicarbonate and phosphate transporters in mineralization and acidosis
name: Bicarbonate and phosphate transporter defects in mineralization and acidosis
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, phosphate and calcium-exchanger transport and their disorders affecting enamel, tooth and ectopic mineralization and renal acidosis; neighbours instead cover type II Na/Pi cotransporters, SLC26 anion exchange and carbonic anhydrase.

core: Cellular cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis
name: LXR-driven cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis limiting foam cells
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse transport, storage and synthesis under LXR control, opposing foam-cell formation; neighbours focus on SREBP-driven synthesis or HDL/LDL particle assembly and remodelling.

name: Nutrient and energy sensing upstream of mTORC1
rationale: Members are amino-acid, glucose and energy (LKB1-AMPK, TSC) inputs that regulate mTORC1 and its translational output; neighbours cover mTORC1/p53 metabolic targets, FOXO and protein methylation.

name: Spliceosomal snRNP biogenesis via snRNA export and cap hypermethylation
rationale: Members cover snRNA transport, cap hypermethylation and snRNP assembly feeding the spliceosome; neighbours cover snRNA transcription, splice-site recognition and mRNA 3'-end processing or decay.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes with intermediate filaments
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly anchoring intermediate filaments
rationale: Members are assembly of intermediate-filament-anchoring junctions (desmosomes, hemidesmosomes) in epithelial adhesion; hemidesmosomes distinguish it from adherens/apical junction, cardiac adhesion and cornification neighbours.

qualifier: regulation of import and export, targeted by RNA virus proteins
name: Nuclear protein import–export regulation exploited by RNA virus proteins
rationale: Members regulate nuclear import and export of proteins together with SARS-CoV and RSV protein maturation and host-targeting events; the regulatory and viral components distinguish it from nuclear pore, Rev export and SUMOylation neighbours.

qualifier: regulated proteolysis and lipid modification of signalling proteins
name: Notch and Hedgehog signalling via regulated proteolysis and lipidation
rationale: Members are Notch receptor processing and transcription, Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing/palmitoylation and GLI signalling, and related intramembrane proteolysis of ERBB4 and p75NTR; neighbours are Wnt destruction-complex, Wnt secretion and beta-catenin themes.

name: p53-dependent intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: Members are p53-driven transcription of death genes, PUMA activation and regulation of intrinsic apoptosis after DNA damage; neighbours cover p53 regulation and cell-cycle arrest or generic BCL-2/mitochondrial apoptosis.

name: Regulation and arrest of oocyte meiotic maturation
rationale: All members regulate oocyte maturation and its meiotic progression, including negative control; neighbours cover meiotic spindle mechanics, germ cell development and ovarian follicle growth.

qualifier: Leishmania immune evasion and bacterial toxin uptake
name: Myeloid host–pathogen interplay: Leishmania evasion and bacterial toxins
rationale: Members are phagocyte and dendritic-cell responses to protozoa, anti-inflammatory evasion programmes in Leishmania infection and uptake of anthrax/diphtheria toxins; neighbours cover Listeria entry, Mtb manipulation, respiratory burst and fungal lectin receptors.

qualifier: FRS2/ARMS adaptors to MAPKs and CREB
name: TRKA signalling via FRS2/ARMS to MAPKs and CREB transcription
rationale: Members are TRKA downstream events through FRS2 and ARMS to ERK5, p38 and CREB-driven transcription; neighbours cover TRKB/TRKC signalling and TRKA activation via PLC-gamma and STAT3.

qualifier: lipoxygenase-derived leukotrienes and lipoxins with their GPCRs
name: Leukotriene and lipoxin metabolism with inflammatory mediator GPCRs
rationale: Members are 5- and 15-lipoxygenase products (leukotrienes, lipoxins, HETEs), their catabolism and receptors plus related inflammatory mediator GPCRs; neighbours centre on cyclooxygenase prostaglandins, P450 HETE/EET pathways and resolvins.

qualifier: epithelial apical–basal polarity and cardiac adhesion
name: Epithelial and cardiac cell junctions with apical–basal polarity
rationale: Members are adherens and desmosomal junctions, apical-basal polarity and cardiomyocyte adhesion; polarity and cardiac intercalated-disc adhesion distinguish it from hemidesmosome and cadherin-assembly neighbours.

core: Heat shock and proteotoxic stress response
qualifier: HSF1 chaperones and stress granule dynamics
name: HSF1 heat shock response and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are HSF1-driven heat shock response, protein refolding and stress granule/PML body regulation under heat and arsenite; neighbours cover ER UPR, chaperonin folding, mitochondrial import and acetylation.

name: Cardiac action potential repolarization via potassium channels
rationale: Members are plateau and repolarization phases of the cardiac action potential carried by voltage-gated, Kir and K2P potassium channels; neighbours cover depolarization, conduction and pacemaker HCN currents.

name: Somite segmentation and posterior body axis elongation
rationale: All members concern somite formation and specification with posterior axis/tail elongation; neighbours cover neural plate, gastrulation and Hox patterning.

name: Alternative complement pathway activation and its positive regulation
rationale: All members concern activation and positive regulation of the alternative complement pathway; neighbours cover classical and lectin activation and complement inhibition.

qualifier: NIK-dependent, via TNFSF receptors and Dectin-1
name: NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-κB signalling via TNFSF receptors and Dectin-1
rationale: Members are NIK activation and non-canonical NF-kB signalling downstream of TNFSF receptors and Dectin-1, with TPL2-ERK activation; neighbours cover canonical IKK/TNFR1/TLR and TCR NF-kB signalling.

name: Carnitine-dependent long-chain fatty acid uptake and β-oxidation control
rationale: Members cover carnitine shuttle/transport, long-chain fatty acid import and regulation of beta-oxidation; neighbours cover fatty acid transporters, medium-chain/malonyl-CoA metabolism and ketone bodies.

name: Visual phototransduction and the retinoid visual cycle
rationale: Members are opsin light detection, the phototransduction cascade and the rod/cone retinoid cycle with their disorders; neighbours cover photoreceptor development or retinoic acid metabolism.

name: Sodium-coupled di- and tricarboxylate membrane transport
rationale: All members are sodium-coupled transport of succinate, citrate and related anions; neighbours cover amino acid/urea metabolism and other organic anion and pyruvate transport.
